description: This file defines a custom lint detector for Android projects that checks for incorrect usage of Compose Material APIs in favor of the project's own design system components. It identifies specific method calls and qualified references, reporting issues when the standard Material components are used instead of the custom 'Nia' prefixed components.

classes.name: DesignSystemDetector
classes.description: A custom lint detector class that checks for improper usage of Compose Material APIs and suggests using the project's design system components instead.

methods.name: getApplicableUastTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of UAST node types (call expressions and qualified references) that this detector is interested in.

methods.name: createUastHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a UElementHandler that processes relevant UAST nodes to identify issues.

methods.name: visitCallExpression
methods.description: Checks method call expressions to see if they match any of the Material components that should be replaced.

methods.name: visitQualifiedReferenceExpression
methods.description: Checks qualified reference expressions for usage of Material icons that should be replaced.

methods.name: reportIssue
methods.description: Reports a lint issue when a standard Material component or icon is used instead of the custom design system component.
